svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — The only motion that always passes unanimously
svg.desc: Black-and-white pen-and-ink newspaper cartoon on the front steps of a fictional colonnaded parliament building at the end of the sitting year. Two fictional MPs from opposite sides, wearing suits with sunglasses pushed up on their heads, walk down the steps arm in arm: one carries a surfboard and a briefcase stuffed with a beach towel, the other a picnic esky. He says: See? We can agree on something. At the top of the steps a fictional usher in a peaked cap rests his hand on a sign reading Adjourned — Parliament returns 2 Feb 2027 — Gone to the beach. On the right a weary cleaner wheels away a trolley piled with papers tagged 123 bills, passed, file away. Gum trees, seagulls and a flag complete the scene. Caption: The only motion that always passes unanimously.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
THE ONLY MOTION THAT ALWAYS PASSES UNANIMOUSLY.
Source: ABC News, 27 November 2026 — Federal Parliament wraps up its sitting year and returns on 2 February 2027.
